verdict.rationale: LobeChat documents data-control postures: chat data is stored locally on the client by default, and self-hosting is described as giving complete control over your data. Agent memory is also editable by the user. However, the evidence never documents explicit retention settings, deletion controls, or cloud-sync data purging. missing for 10: documented retention-period controls, explicit conversation/account deletion features, deletion behavior for cloud-synced data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: LobeChat chat data is stored locally on the client-side by default.
